title: Make Your Own Advent Calendar – 24 Empty Boxes to Fill
seo_description: You decide exactly what the recipient gets behind each door, instead of a factory choice.
descriptionHtml:
Ready-made calendars decide for you

You want to give an advent calendar that feels chosen for that particular person, not 24 things a factory has already decided. The pre-filled calendars almost always have 24 identical compartments regardless of what's supposed to go in them, so a gift that isn't exactly the right size simply doesn't fit.

Empty when it arrives, filled your way

This advent calendar arrives completely empty: no contents included, you choose and fill all 24 things yourself. The boxes are different sizes (smallest 3 × 4.5 × 7 cm, largest 7 × 24.5 × 7 cm), so a gift fits in the right compartment instead of being forced into the same dimensions as everything else. The lid folds open like a book and shows all 24 numbered boxes at once, so you can see what's already filled and what's left.

What you get

  • You decide exactly what the recipient gets behind each door, instead of a factory choice.
  • Different box sizes mean both a small note and a bulkier gift get a compartment of their own.
  • The lid shows all 24 boxes at once, so you can see in advance which ones are missing contents.
  • The ribbon handle means the whole calendar can be carried like a bag, for example when it's being given away already filled.
  • Outer box 34 × 30.5 × 8 cm, weighs 805 g, with a ribbon handle in the lid
  • 24 numbered boxes (1–24) in 14 different sizes, all 7 cm deep
  • Smallest box 3 × 4.5 × 7 cm, largest 7 × 24.5 × 7 cm
  • Rigid cardboard covered with coated paper, four-color print
  • Each box has its own number and its own Christmas-printed illustration (snowman, fir tree, string of lights, bauble, stocking)
  • Delivered completely empty – no contents included

Frequently asked questions

Does anything come inside the boxes?
No. The calendar is delivered completely empty – the outer box and all 24 small boxes, but no contents. You choose and fill them yourself.

Can the boxes be opened and closed many times, or only once?
We can't promise they'll hold up to being opened again and again year after year – the supplier states nothing about it. Handle them gently if you want to save the calendar for next Christmas.

How big are the boxes, and what fits?
The 24 boxes are 7 cm deep and vary in width: smallest 3 × 4.5 × 7 cm, largest 7 × 24.5 × 7 cm. Those are the measurements we have, so please measure what you plan to put in before you choose a compartment.

Is there an age limit or a warning label on the packaging?
We have no information about age marking or warning text on this product.

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
